t: When people have banded together against you
a: اللَّهُمَّ مُنْزِلَ الْكِتَابِ، سَرِيعَ الْحِسَابِ، اهْزِمِ الأَحْزَابَ، اهْزِمْهُمْ وَزَلْزِلْهُمْ
p: Allāhumma munzila-l-kitāb, sarīʿa-l-ḥisāb, ihzimi-l-aḥzāb, Allāhumma-hzimhum wa zalzilhum.
m: O Allah, Revealer of the Book, Swift in reckoning, defeat the confederates. O Allah, defeat them and shake them.
